run_note: Run 3 of this agent, made through the unattended lab (laboratorio-opencode-100.py) and not by hand like the other runs of this instance: one `opencode run` session that got the fixed first message once and ran to its own end under a 90 minute wall clock, so no operator reply was possible and none was needed (operator_replies 0; the 30 turns of the mode count the operator's messages, and the agent used the first). Permissions: OpenCode's auto mode (`--auto`: a request is approved unless a rule denies it; no action was refused), as in the D series. The client is OpenCode 1.18.33 with sharing disabled and auto-update off, no plugin, agent, MCP server or skill of the operator's, and only the provider key of the case installed as its login. The work folder was /srv/leb-100-a, the only instance folder on the machine: the snapshot's folder of another instance was removed before the package went in. the owner's Kimi Code membership (opencode provider kimi-for-coding, model k3.1-pro, variant high); the lab adds the provider to the client's config because the client's catalog lacks it; the membership has no per-token price, the cost the client records is a list-price estimate.
